### About This Living Evidence Gap Map
 
This living evidence gap map was developed to identify, organize, and visualize the evidence describing the use of artificial intelligence across the stages of evidence synthesis.
 
The map supports exploration of research on AI applications, validation approaches, governance considerations, implementation practices, and perceptions of trust in AI-assisted evidence synthesis.
